families.shared_source_predicates: Expand every reachable source/envelope/SP-278/SP-286 schema assertion using the reviewed shared tool in phase 2. No whole-keyword or unrelated-predicate removal set is permitted.
families.case_execution_rule: Every guard row is a required planned positive/one-defect negative. Run per applicable edition and path, one component/dependency/occurrence at a time; no aggregate rule substitutes for its leaves. Current-write/retry authorization checks never govern original retained history. Failure is nonzero with its named refusal and zero new effects, including no second native effect, append, receipt, projector publication or external call. An already committed native result remains pending/resolvable under its original owner.

positive_branches: Valid Project original
Lost reply returns original event/result/first receipt without a second native effect
Valid retained original after live state/permission generation/strict number rule changes, with currently authorized reader
Valid retained compatibility/projector-replay-only history on separate passive read path
Empty matching set over a proven nonempty generic global captured range
SP-337 full payload route over the inline limit with all stored parts bounded
Valid application original with actual Server/Computer/thread and project_id=null

Retained authentic original remains inspectable after writer lease loss, write-permission revocation, changed CAS/owner/Stop or cancellation state, using original admission/edition and current authorized disclosure; never retry the old native mutation.

SP-337 full payload route over the inline limit with all stored parts bounded

after last returning helper immediately before actual guarded write/release

guards.predicate: a syntactically valid independent identifier/digest selector preserves the exact original source spelling
guards.positive: The valid independent selector equals the authentic original spelling under its selected edition.

negative.mutation: Use only a different syntactically valid independent spelling expectation; preserve authentic original bytes, valid full-match grammar and all peer source/identity expectations.

guards.isolation: Recompute only deterministic dependent copies/keys/commitments. Keep independent authentic sources immutable. If multiple enforcement sites test this same field and predicate, enumerate that predicate-only duplicate set; remove each site separately then all sites. Distinct predicates never share a removal set. Prove using reviewed scripts/pm_guard_isolation.py in phase 2.
guards.branch_rule: Each named component/participant is tested separately on every owner-defined branch where it is required. A nonparticipating optional Crew/Goal/run/Project is not fabricated. Preserve original admission and edition for retained reads.
guards.case_boundary: Original-source spelling join after successful owner grammar validation.

families.unknown_or_withdrawn_selector: Read-only unavailable; never relabel or mutate historical original
families.failure_exit: Every rejecting fixture must produce nonzero validation exit, with its named refusal; a success exit is itself a test failure.

families.shared_source_predicates: Expand every reachable source/envelope/SP-278/SP-286 schema assertion using the reviewed shared tool in phase 2. No whole-keyword or unrelated-predicate removal set is permitted.
families.case_execution_rule: Every guard row is a required planned positive/one-defect negative. Run per applicable edition and path, one component/dependency/occurrence at a time; no aggregate rule substitutes for its leaves. Current-write/retry authorization checks never govern original retained history. Failure is nonzero with its named refusal and zero new effects, including no second native effect, append, receipt, projector publication or external call. An already committed native result remains pending/resolvable under its original owner.

positive_branches: Valid Project original
Lost reply returns original event/result/first receipt without a second native effect
Valid retained original after live state/permission generation/strict number rule changes, with currently authorized reader
Valid retained compatibility/projector-replay-only history on separate passive read path
Empty matching set over a proven nonempty generic global captured range
SP-337 full payload route over the inline limit with all stored parts bounded
Valid application original with actual Server/Computer/thread and project_id=null

Retained authentic original remains inspectable after writer lease loss, write-permission revocation, changed CAS/owner/Stop or cancellation state, using original admission/edition and current authorized disclosure; never retry the old native mutation.

SP-337 full payload route over the inline limit with all stored parts bounded

families.shared_source_predicates: Expand every reachable source/envelope/SP-278/SP-286 schema assertion using the reviewed shared tool in phase 2. No whole-keyword or unrelated-predicate removal set is permitted.
families.case_execution_rule: Every guard row is a required planned positive/one-defect negative. Run per applicable edition and path, one component/dependency/occurrence at a time; no aggregate rule substitutes for its leaves. Current-write/retry authorization checks never govern original retained history. Failure is nonzero with its named refusal and zero new effects, including no second native effect, append, receipt, projector publication or external call. An already committed native result remains pending/resolvable under its original owner.

positive_branches: Valid Project original
Lost reply returns original event/result/first receipt without a second native effect
Valid retained original after live state/permission generation/strict number rule changes, with currently authorized reader
Valid retained compatibility/projector-replay-only history on separate passive read path
Empty matching set over a proven nonempty generic global captured range
SP-337 full payload route over the inline limit with all stored parts bounded
Application current write refused; no fabricated Project

Retained authentic original remains inspectable after writer lease loss, write-permission revocation, changed CAS/owner/Stop or cancellation state, using original admission/edition and current authorized disclosure; never retry the old native mutation.

families.case_execution_rule: Every guard row is a required planned positive/one-defect negative. It cannot authorize a current write/retry, be relabelled V2 or receive a fabricated cancellation_pending=null upgrade. A retained V2 original keeps its original V2 admission/edition despite later cancellation or Stop. Current disclosure/deletion/withdrawal remains separate. Application sources retain their distinct original GRS-086/CV-366 selected graph; no Project control or hash is cast into an application value and unresolved original app custody leaves the route unavailable.

A retained V2 original keeps its original V2 admission/edition despite later cancellation or Stop. Current disclosure/deletion/withdrawal remains separate. families.shared_source_predicates: Expand every reachable source/envelope/SP-278/SP-286 schema assertion using the reviewed shared tool in phase 2. No whole-keyword or unrelated-predicate removal set is permitted.
families.case_execution_rule: Every guard row is a required planned positive/one-defect negative. Run per applicable edition and path, one component/dependency/occurrence at a time; no aggregate rule substitutes for its leaves. Current-write/retry authorization checks never govern original retained history. Failure is nonzero with its named refusal and zero new effects, including no second native effect, append, receipt, projector publication or external call. An already committed native result remains pending/resolvable under its original owner.

positive_branches: Valid Project original
Lost reply returns original event/result/first receipt without a second native effect
Valid retained original after live state/permission generation/strict number rule changes, with currently authorized reader
Valid retained compatibility/projector-replay-only history on separate passive read path
Empty matching set over a proven nonempty generic global captured range
SP-337 full payload route over the inline limit with all stored parts bounded
Valid application original with actual Server/Computer/thread and project_id=null

Retained authentic original remains inspectable after writer lease loss, write-permission revocation, changed CAS/owner/Stop or cancellation state, using original admission/edition and current authorized disclosure; never retry the old native mutation.

families.shared_source_predicates: Expand every reachable source/envelope/SP-278/SP-286 schema assertion using the reviewed shared tool in phase 2. No whole-keyword or unrelated-predicate removal set is permitted.
families.case_execution_rule: Every guard row is a required planned positive/one-defect negative. Run per applicable edition and path, one component/dependency/occurrence at a time; no aggregate rule substitutes for its leaves. Current-write/retry authorization checks never govern original retained history. Failure is nonzero with its named refusal and zero new effects, including no second native effect, append, receipt, projector publication or external call. An already committed native result remains pending/resolvable under its original owner.

positive_branches: Valid Project original
Lost reply returns original event/result/first receipt without a second native effect
Valid retained original after live state/permission generation/strict number rule changes, with currently authorized reader
Valid retained compatibility/projector-replay-only history on separate passive read path
Empty matching set over a proven nonempty generic global captured range
SP-337 full payload route over the inline limit with all stored parts bounded
Valid application original with actual Server/Computer/thread and project_id=null

Retained authentic original remains inspectable after writer lease loss, write-permission revocation, changed CAS/owner/Stop or cancellation state, using original admission/edition and current authorized disclosure; never retry the old native mutation.

families.shared_source_predicates: Expand every reachable source/envelope/SP-278/SP-286 schema assertion using the reviewed shared tool in phase 2. No whole-keyword or unrelated-predicate removal set is permitted.
families.case_execution_rule: Every guard row is a required planned positive/one-defect negative. Run per applicable edition and path, one component/dependency/occurrence at a time; no aggregate rule substitutes for its leaves. Current-write/retry authorization checks never govern original retained history. Failure is nonzero with its named refusal and zero new effects, including no second native effect, append, receipt, projector publication or external call. An already committed native result remains pending/resolvable under its original owner.

predicate_inventory_policy: Split compound runtime guards into separate guard rows. Payload schema assertion leaves remain in schema_predicate_inventory; source/envelope schema leaves are expanded eagerly with the reviewed shared tool in phase 2. No proof is claimed in phase 1.

path_boundaries.current_write: New current mutation/append admission; all current writer predicates apply at their actual boundary.
path_boundaries.current_retry: A retry that would perform current mutation/append revalidates current writer predicates. If native effect already committed, keep its original result pending/resolvable without repeating it.
path_boundaries.retained_original: Read/resolve an immutable already committed original through authenticated original admission/edition and current disclosure policy. No reacquisition of live writer lease, write permission, owner/CAS/Stop/cancellation or migration into current schemas.

phase2.numbers: scripts/pm_w3g_numbers.py (shared NUMRULE corpus through the complete routes)
phase2.plan_guard_mapping: Each plan guard <family>:<suffix> is a table row of pm_w3g_events (common phases ad, sc, pf, en, nm, tm, src, pj, ej, sj, wr, id, st, ry, rr, rd, rs; family phases py_<slug>, fx_<slug>); compound plan rows are split further where one clause had two predicates. The runner maps every schema_predicate_inventory site to its row or to a written implication.
